about_the_game:
Bit Lost

"Sometimes, to find your way out, you first need to get lost."

Bit Lost is a single-player, first-person atmospheric adventure set in a fractured digital space. Step into the mind of a lost consciousness and explore mysterious environments filled with glitching terminals and hidden memories.

Journey through diverse locations — from abandoned corridors and empty apartments to corrupted forests and the core of the system. Solve simple puzzles, navigate tricky pathways, and piece together the story through environmental clues and a subtle voice guiding your way.

Experience a deep sense of isolation and discovery, as you unravel the truth behind your presence in this digital labyrinth. The game focuses on exploration, atmosphere, and narrative immersion — no combat or enemies, just you and the fading echoes of a forgotten world.

---

Features:

Single-player exploration with rich atmospheric storytelling

Diverse, immersive locations representing fragments of a digital mind

Interactive terminals to unlock new areas and progress the story

Puzzle-solving and navigation challenges

Subtle voiced narrative elements adding depth to the experience

Complete solo development — from concept and design to sound and voice.

---

---

From the developer:

This project was developed entirely solo, with a focus on creating a complete and immersive experience. Future updates may include achievements, additional gameplay mechanics, and alternate endings. Feedback and support are greatly appreciated — thank you!

I’m open to ideas and feedback — help Bit Lost become what it’s meant to be.

> “At first, I planned to add monsters, QTEs, and world switching. But working solo meant I had to focus on what’s most important. For now, the main goal is that you get to the finale… and really feel something.”

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: ОС Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (4 GB) / AMD R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for stable performance. For the best experience, use headphones.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: ОС Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: An SSD and headphones are strongly recommended for full immersion.

short_description: Bit Lost is a single-player atmospheric first-person game set inside a broken digital space. Explore fragments of consciousness to uncover what happened and find a way out.
